en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Zahaar does not occur upon the anger’.
en.sarwar: 25. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Al-Zihar (calling one’s wife as one’s mother) does not take place upon anger (if expressed because of anger).”’
